shortDescription: Copper output in Peru, the world's third-largest producer of the red metal, rose 3.7% year-over-year in July to 236,515 metric tons, the energy and mines ministry said on Wednesday.From January to July, production rose 2.2% year-over-year to 1.6 million metric tons, the ministry added.

From January to July, production rose 2.2% year-over-year to 1.6 million metric tons, the ministry added.
